name: opc
description: Connect Codex to your OPC Suite workspace. Manage contacts, sales orders, inventory, accounting, HRM, payroll, projects, expense claims, and documents — all from natural language inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, HR & expense claims via AI
interface.longDescription: OPC Suite is an all-in-one business operations platform for SMBs. With this plugin Codex can read and write contacts, leads, deals, sales orders, quotations, products, inventory, suppliers, purchases, accounting (P&L, balance sheet, journals, AR/AP), HRM (employees, leave, attendance), payroll, projects, support tickets, expense claims and the documents library — all gated by your personal API token's scopes.
defaultPrompt: List my pending expense claims and summarise total amount.
Show me today's sales orders grouped by customer.
Create a new contact for Acme Corp with primary contact john@acme.com.
What's my Profit & Loss for last month?
Find all overdue invoices and draft polite reminder emails.
